families.offset: PRIMARY: vacuum fixed at 0; all positive spectral coordinates receive the same downward translation. Internal positive-spectrum pairwise spacings are preserved exactly while the vacuum gap tends to 0+.
families.upctrl: MATCHED MASSIVE CONTROL: vacuum fixed at 0; all positive coordinates receive the same upward translation of equal magnitude.
families.scale: NULL N1: vacuum fixed at 0; every positive coordinate is multiplied by epsilon. Spectral ratios are preserved while the whole spectrum collapses homogeneously toward the vacuum.
families.gaponly: NULL N2: vacuum fixed at 0; only c1 is multiplied by epsilon. The remaining positive coordinates are unchanged.
